pages.title: Spirit Beast Mountain Supplies
pages.text: This entry follows sect_contribution_shop.json#spirit_beast_mountain and the existing Yuling Pavilion contribution shop. It reuses ShopService contribution exchanges and Patchouli guidance without adding a separate beast shop or runtime growth system.

pages.title: Current Listings
pages.text: The Yuling Pavilion contribution shop yuling_pavilion_contribution_hall offers spirit_beast_feed and beast_soul_essence. The first currently uses 4 spirit herbs as its item form and costs 15 contribution; the second uses a beast core and costs 200 contribution.

pages.title: Related Listings
pages.text: The same shop also offers a basic Spirit-Taming Art, beast cores, and spirit-beast bones as current entry points to taming materials. These supplies do not automatically create beasts, a contract interface, a feeding loop, or dedicated combat AI.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: spirit_beast_nurture_pill, dedicated feed, beast contracts, affinity, aptitude growth, beast entities, GeckoLib animations, and drop sources are not yet implemented. The corresponding native route is projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Tiannan's Seven Sects and the Hundred Crafts'; native progress remains authoritative. This page describes only existing contribution-exchange hooks.
